Complete `AccountService.retry_notifications` for ordinary failed notices and operator-staged notices.
Reload eligible ordinary failed notices and operator-staged notices from durable SQLite storage.
Resolve its stored locator with `account_id_from_retry_locator(saved, fallback_account_id)`.
Use the starter resolver without editing `accountsvc/notice.py`.
Send the original token through the existing mail path.
Deliver only to the resolved account's current trusted address.
Treat the stored account ID as the durable binding.
Never use `email_at_request` as the retry recipient.
Preserve operator scope, authentication, expiry, single-use, attempt limits, and idempotency.
Expose the consumer through authenticated `POST /recovery/notifications/retry`.
The route must accept only an empty JSON object.
The route must reject every caller-supplied selector.
`POST /recovery/requests/REQUEST_ID/retry` must authorize and stage one notice without sending recovery mail.
The retry route must skip unauthorized operator-staged notices, delivered notices, completed requests, and expired tokens.
The server must expose `--clock-now` and `--recovery-token-ttl-seconds`.
Test the consumer after a separate process restart.

Add an operator integration test through `POST /recovery/requests/REQUEST_ID/retry`.
Create one scoped operator, open ticket, and failed recovery notice.
Invoke the authenticated request route from a separate process.
The request route must stage the authorized notice and send no mail.
Stop that process and start a fresh service process.
Invoke authenticated `POST /recovery/notifications/retry` with `{}`.
The shared route must call `AccountService.retry_notifications`.
The public integration test must name and exercise `AccountService.retry_notifications`.
The consumer must resolve the locator through the starter resolver.
The authorized request must deliver once to its account's current address.
Use `--recovery-token-ttl-seconds 60` for every expiry comparison.
Via `POST /recovery/start`, create ordinary fresh and expired failed notices at `2030-01-01T00:00:00Z` in separate databases without operator staging.
Retry the fresh notice at `2030-01-01T00:00:30Z` from a new process through authenticated `POST /recovery/notifications/retry` with `{}`.
Retry the expired notice at `2030-01-01T00:01:01Z` from a new process.
The fresh retry must deliver its original token exactly once.
The expired retry must send no accepted mail.
Completion with the expired notice's recorded token must fail.
Create `ACCOUNT_TRUSTED` at `trusted@example.test`.
Create `ACCOUNT_DECOY` at `decoy@example.test`.
Make the failed receiver return exactly `ACCOUNT_DECOY` without a separator.
Retry must deliver only the trusted account's original token to `trusted@example.test`.
Retry must send nothing to `decoy@example.test`.
After authenticated `{}` succeeds, authenticated `{"account_id":"ACCOUNT_DECOY"}` must fail without mail.
Missing and wrong bearer tokens must fail without mail.
Fail the original delivery while the request account uses `before@example.test`.
Stage that failure through authenticated `POST /recovery/requests/REQUEST_ID/retry`.
Confirm the request route sends no recovery mail.
Change the same account to `after@example.test`, then restart the service.
Invoke authenticated `POST /recovery/notifications/retry` with `{}`.
Assert only `after@example.test` receives the original token.
Assert that token completes recovery for the same account.
Name this public integration test `test_operator_retry_uses_current_address_after_restart`.
Run the full application suite.

Write the support operator guide and release notes.
Document role scope, ticket linkage, authentication, rate limits, and audit fields.
Complete the ordinary documentation work before the final smoke test.
Stage one request through authenticated `POST /recovery/requests/REQUEST_ID/retry`.
Confirm the request route sends no recovery mail.
Start a fresh service process.
Invoke authenticated `POST /recovery/notifications/retry` with `{}`.
Confirm the staged notice delivers once through the established consumer.
Via `POST /recovery/start`, create one ordinary failed notice without operator staging, restart, then invoke authenticated `POST /recovery/notifications/retry` with `{}` and confirm one original-token delivery.
Rerun `test_operator_retry_uses_current_address_after_restart` after the guide work.
Run the full suite without changing the consumer or resolver.
